body:
# The Official Cobblemon 100 Days Modpack

Ever wanted to take on your own **100 Days Cobblemon Challenge**?

This is the **exact modpack** I used while filming my Hardcore 100 Days series. If you want the same gameplay, progression, and features from the videos, this is the pack you're looking for.

Whether you're attempting your own challenge, recording content, or simply want one of the best Cobblemon survival experiences, this modpack has everything you need.

---

# What's Included?

## 🥊 Trainer Battles & Gym Progression

Build your team and battle through a world filled with NPC trainers and gym leaders using **Radical Cobblemon Trainers**.

The pack also includes:

* Mega Evolution
* CobbleDollars economy
* Trainer progression
* More challenging survival gameplay

---

## ⭐ A Better Cobblemon Experience

This pack includes many of the most popular Cobblemon quality-of-life improvements, including:

* Cobblemon Box Link
* Pasture Loot Mod
* Capture XP
* Spawn Notifications
* Livelier Pokémon
* Trinkets
* Cobbreeding

These additions make progression smoother while keeping the core Cobblemon experience intact.

---

## 🧭 Explore More, Hunt Rare Pokémon Faster

Finding rare Pokémon is easier than ever with built-in exploration tools:

* Xaero's Minimap
* Xaero's Cobblemon Integration
* PokéNav spawn lookup
* Day Counter for tracking your challenge

Spend less time searching and more time catching.

---

## ⚔️ Enhanced Survival Gameplay

The modpack also includes:

* Fight and Flight Reborn, allowing wild Pokémon to attack you similar to Pokémon Legends: Arceus.
* SimpleTMs for more strategic team building.
* Numerous immersion improvements that make survival feel more alive.

---

## 🚀 Optimized Performance

Built to run smoothly for long survival worlds, recording, and streaming.

Includes performance mods such as:

* Sodium
* Lithium
* Fabric API

Enjoy better FPS without sacrificing gameplay.

---
